name: realestate-windows-electron
description: Electron shell for the Black Label Real Estate Windows UI — the A/B sibling of the Tauri/WebView2 shell in ../windows. Same payload, different shell.

scripts.package:win: npm run smoke && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
scripts.package:store: npm run smoke && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
